extracted.name: Green Smoothie
extracted.description: Our favorite easy Green Smoothie recipe is delicious and refreshing made with veggies and fruit.
ingredient_lines: 1 cup chopped kale (, packed, large ribs removed)
4 ounces sliced apple ((about 1/2 of a medium apple))
¾ teaspoon refrigerated pureed ginger (, or fresh minced ginger)
instruction_lines: Add all ingredients to a high-power blender and blend until smooth.
categories: How to make a green smoothie
